security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown examples, relative documentation links, or metadata rather than active code. Two medium-confidence command findings are confirmed because the skill recommends local Python helper invocations with user-provided URLs. No prompt injection or malicious data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Local helper command examples accept user-provided URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running helpers, pass URLs as quoted arguments, and prefer structured tool calls when available.

remediation.issue: Network crawling expectations are implied across several audit paths.
remediation.suggestion: State that crawlers should fetch only user-approved URLs and should not send page content to third-party services without confirmation.

remediation.issue: Many cross-references use parent-directory paths that trigger traversal alerts.
remediation.suggestion: Use package-local links where possible, or label parent-directory references as documentation-only links.

content.user_title: Audit On-Page SEO with Prioritized Fixes
content.value_statement: Single-page SEO issues are hard to prioritize when titles, meta descriptions, headings, links, images, and keywords interact. This skill produces scored diagnostics and a prioritized repair plan for page-level optimization.
actual_capabilities: Scores title tags, meta descriptions, headers, keywords, links, images, and page-level tags.
Produces per-section scores and an overall on-page SEO score.
Ranks fixes by P0, P1, and P2 priority levels.
Infers a target keyword when none is provided and labels it as estimated.
Supports competitor comparison and bulk audits through sampling and extrapolation.
Uses templates and checklists for blog posts, product pages, and landing pages.
limitations: It is not a full technical SEO crawler or Core Web Vitals auditor.
It does not replace keyword research or search volume validation.
It provides a CORE-EEAT quick scan, not a publish-readiness verdict.
URL audits depend on available page access, HTML quality, and connected tools.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Ranking Drop
use_cases.description: Review one page for structural SEO issues and identify likely fixes for lost visibility.

use_cases.title: Prepare Content Before Publishing
use_cases.description: Check draft content for title, heading, keyword, link, and image gaps before release.

use_cases.title: Audit a Page Batch
use_cases.description: Sample several URLs, find recurring template issues, and prioritize portfolio-level repairs.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Page Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the on-page SEO of this URL: [URL]. Use the page content and list the highest-impact fixes first.

prompt_templates.title: Keyword-Focused Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Single page with a known target keyword.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this page for the target keyword [keyword]: [URL or pasted content]. Score each section and recommend exact fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare one page against another page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare on-page SEO for [your URL] against [competitor URL] for [keyword]. Identify gaps, advantages, and priority changes.

prompt_templates.title: Bulk Pattern Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Bulk audit these URLs for on-page SEO patterns: [URL list]. Cluster pages, sample each cluster, and report portfolio priorities.

output_examples.input: Audit a blog post targeting best noise cancelling headphones.
output_examples.output: Returns section scores for title, meta, headers, content, keywords, links, images, and page-level tags, plus P0 and P1 fixes.

output_examples.input: Compare a product page with a competitor for a commercial keyword.
output_examples.output: Highlights title, heading, content depth, internal link, schema, and image gaps with recommended copy and structure changes.

output_examples.input: Audit 40 blog URLs from one site section.
output_examples.output: Groups URLs by template, samples each group, estimates recurring issues, and lists portfolio-level repair priorities.

best_practices: Provide the URL, target keyword, page type, and business goal when possible.
Ask the skill to label every metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Validate inferred keywords with search volume data before production changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a full crawl, indexing, or Core Web Vitals audit.
Do not treat inferred keyword recommendations as final keyword research.
Do not ask for broad site strategy when one-page evidence is missing.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch live pages?
faq.answer: It can use available page access tools when permitted. You can also paste HTML or page content.

faq.question: Can it audit a page without a target keyword?
faq.answer: Yes. It infers a candidate keyword from the content and labels that choice as estimated.

faq.question: Does it cover technical SEO?
faq.answer: It checks page-level tags and basic technical signals. Use a technical SEO tool for crawl, indexing, and Core Web Vitals.

faq.question: Can it handle many URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. For five or more URLs, it groups pages, samples each cluster, and reports recurring issues.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect scored sections, evidence, prioritized fixes, quick wins, and a concise handoff summary.

faq.question: Is it suitable for publish-readiness scoring?
faq.answer: No. It includes a quick CORE-EEAT scan, but publish-readiness needs a dedicated content quality audit.
